description_en: Modifies the default log field configuration of a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance for log delivery to Simple Log Service
description_zh: 修改用户日志服务的默认字段配置
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-user-log-field-config --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-fou0000 --field-list account,acl_action,acl_rule_id,acl_rule_type,acl_test,antiscan_action,antiscan_rule_id,antiscan_rule_type,antiscan_test,body_bytes_sent,bypass_matched_ids --extend-config request_header_:_App-Id,channelCode --delivery-type sls --log-delivery-strategy logType_:_blockLog_,_rate_:100_,_logType_:_normalRequestLog_,_rate_:100_,_logType_:_checkLog_,_rate_:100 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyUserLogFieldConfig

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to view the ID of your WAF instance.
parameters.description_zh:

parameters.description_en:
The list of log fields to deliver. Use the \`a,b,c,...\` format.

> - You must include all required log fields. Call the [DescribeCommonLogFields](~~DescribeCommonLogFields~~) operation to view the log fields that WAF supports.
>
> - If the log fields include **request\_header**, use the **ExtendConfig** parameter to specify the request headers to deliver.
parameters.description_zh:
需投递的日志字段列表。使用"a,b,c,……"格式表示。

>   - 需要包含所有必选日志字段, 您可以通过调用[DescribeCommonLogFields](~~DescribeCommonLogFields~~)接口查看WAF日志服务支持的日志字段信息。 
> - 当日志字段中包含**request_header**时，需要使用**投递扩展配置**（**ExtendConfig**）参数指定需要投递的请求头。
